parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular cover made of stainless steel, fitting on top of the pot to retain heat and prevent spillage.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the pot, maintaining temperature and preventing contaminants from entering.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the container; it is detachable and not fixed to the main body.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is the main cylindrical body of the pot, made of stainless steel, designed to hold liquids or food.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the contents being cooked or stored, providing the main volume of the pot.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and serves as the central structure; it does not move independently.

parts.name: Bottom
parts.Basic_description: The bottom is the base of the pot, made of stainless steel, providing stability and heat conduction.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the pot and ensures even heat distribution when placed on a stove or surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move; it remains in contact with the heating surface.
